# VisualBuild Hub products

Three separate hardware products. Product guides describe setup, compatibility and limitations.

## FlexHub
iPad + Apple Pencil pressure drawing on Windows and Mac; USB Pen mode, browser shortcuts and macros.
iPad 与 Apple Pencil 连接电脑绘画，USB Pen 模式支持压感。
- Product: https://visualbuild.shop/flexhub.html
- Guide: https://visualbuild.shop/guide.html
- Video: https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1ipyUzoExk/
- China purchase: https://item.taobao.com/item.htm?id=1102448173286

## TransferHub
Local cross-platform phone and computer file transfer via browser, Wi-Fi and USB; no cloud relay in local mode.
手机与电脑跨平台本地文件互传，无需网盘中转。
- Product: https://visualbuild.shop/transferhub.html
- Guide: https://visualbuild.shop/transferhub-guide.html
- Video: https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1yf17zRE2V/
- China purchase: https://item.taobao.com/item.htm?id=1103567020238

## StackHub
MCP hardware gateway for controlled AI access to configured local tools on an offline computer via USB bridge.
通过 USB 硬件网关，让支持 MCP 的 AI 受控调用离线电脑的本地工具。
- Product: https://visualbuild.shop/stackhub.html
- Guide: https://visualbuild.shop/stackhub-guide.html
- Video: https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1Zi1JzEEG1/
- China purchase: https://item.taobao.com/item.htm?id=1100848807774
